finding: Early initiation of antenatal care (within 16 weeks) is associated with a lower rate of caesarean section, while receiving comprehensive antenatal care, being an urban resident, primiparity, and having three or more antenatal care visits are associated with an increased likelihood of caesarean section.
mod_finding: Women initiated antenatal care in the first trimester (AOR = 2.74; 95% CI = 1.49-6.2) and received contents of care (AOR = 1.98; 95% CI = 1.24-3.78])were more likely to have caesarean section delivery as compared to their counterparts.
